profile.name: Saood Ghare
profile.bio: I build scalable, high-performance web applications with Next.js, React, and Laravel — turning complex business requirements into elegant digital experiences.
intro: Full Stack Developer with a Mechanical Engineering background and 2.5+ years of experience building scalable web applications and e-commerce platforms. Specialized in React, Next.js, Node.js, Laravel, and cloud technologies, with a strong focus on performance, security, and API-driven architectures.

Currently working as a Full Stack Developer at Ahmed Al Maghribi Perfumes in Ajman, UAE, where I develop and maintain high-traffic e-commerce platforms, build complex API integrations, implement payment solutions including Tabby, Tamara, PayTabs, and PayFort, and work with AWS and Cloudways infrastructure.

Previously at AutomateBuddy Technologies, I worked extensively with React.js, Redux Toolkit, .NET Core, and PostgreSQL, building responsive enterprise interfaces and backend APIs while focusing on maintainability, security, and reliable data management.

I enjoy turning complex business requirements into reliable, scalable solutions. From developing localized e-commerce experiences and cross-device cart systems to optimizing APIs, databases, and server performance, I focus on building products that are fast, secure, and practical.
profile.quote: Passionate about creating digital experiences that bridge the gap between aesthetics and functionality.
profile.contactMessage: I'm always open to discussing new projects, creative ideas, or opportunities to be part of your visions. Connect with me on my social platforms or drop me an email.

projects.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi
projects.description: Architected a multi-region headless e-commerce platform managing 6 country codebases. Engineered a persistent cross-device cart system, integrated fintech APIs (Tabby/Tamara), and built high-performance landing pages using Next.js 14 and GSAP animations.

projects.title: The Diet Cascade
projects.description: Delivered a high-performance custom web solution for the healthcare sector. Achieved 100% Google Lighthouse scores for Performance and SEO by optimizing asset loading and server response times on Hostinger.

projects.title: Sober Estate
projects.description: A responsive real estate web platform developed with a focus on modern UI, property listings, search and filtering, project showcases, and lead-generation functionality. Built with scalable frontend architecture and API-driven functionality to deliver a fast and user-friendly experience across devices.

projects.title: City Prime Group
projects.description: A modern corporate web platform developed for a diversified business group operating across real estate, hospitality, infrastructure development, and telecommunications. Built with a responsive interface, structured business-sector pages, project showcases, service sections, and lead-generation functionality, with a focus on performance, scalability, and a professional digital presence.

projects.title: Procon Media
projects.description: Developed a fully responsive digital agency interface using Tailwind CSS. Optimized the deployment pipeline via cPanel to ensure SSL compliance, fast rendering, and maximum search engine visibility for lead generation.
